scope: All methods inventoried and ownership classified; 32 compiler methods assessed at assertion level. Infrastructure methods are not independently re-proven or rerun by this audit.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Tail/ABI coverage is useful; a particular setp.ge spelling is not the output invariant.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Tail handling is useful; shfl.sync.bfly/bar.sync spellings are specific to one reduction implementation.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Participation and masked memory are essential. Specific predicates/branches are mechanism checks; an equivalent collective-free or uniformly guarded lowering may differ.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Nested participation coverage is useful; predicate polarity/spelling alone is not a semantic oracle.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Current unsupported-mapping rejection check, not a permanent compiler requirement to reject that mapping. A correct general implementation may accept it; retain as a capability-specific negative test.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Duplicate positional arguments are a real invalid-contract error. Keep as ABI validation.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Scalar-vs-pointer ABI is relevant; exact param/register arithmetic spellings should only check the selected ABI implementation.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: XYZ ID calculation is relevant; mandatory mad.lo.u32 unnecessarily fixes one implementation.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Inactive max identities are relevant. Requiring predicated max/mov is stronger than allowing any semantically neutral padding.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Natural-log semantics matter, but lg2 plus ln2 is an implementation choice; another approximate implementation within tolerance is valid.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Aliases should denote the same operation. Testing a fixed add opcode is a local emitter unit test rather than proof that all equivalent reductions must use it.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Type/transport bug is real, but requiring mov.s32 rejects valid register aliasing/copy elimination. Compare output/bit transport and assembly legality instead of requiring a copy instruction.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Destination width and numeric conversion are real requirements. Mandatory conversion opcodes should not forbid equivalent conversion/constant propagation.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: The nonzero shared-window base semantic check earns its keep. Specific cp.async.cg, scalar label, predicate and arithmetic spellings are mechanism-specific; alternatives preserving alignment and address semantics are valid.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Unsafe aligned cp.async on an unaligned address must be prevented. Entirely forbidding the vector spelling is stronger: a guarded aligned branch, alternate safe vectorization or scalar path is acceptable.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Performance-shape snapshot: assumes backedges, division/remainder forms and loop structure. Useful only for the hoisting mechanism; valid unrolling/retiling/strength reduction may violate it. Do not use as a universal correctness blocker.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Definition analysis must see nested Cond/Loop bindings before hoisting or caching. This small analysis-helper contract prevents stale values and does not fix an FP instruction sequence; retain when scope/hoist analysis changes.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Lexical join correctness earns a test; mandatory endif labels and mad.lo.s32 address form are brittle implementation assertions.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Correct outer address in the false arm is essential; exact else labels, branch polarity and mad.lo.s32 forms should not obstruct equivalent predication/control flow.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Address invalidation is real, but expecting two loads, add.s32, mad.lo.s32 and mov.b32 can reject valid dead-load elimination or alternate address arithmetic. Replace the shape check with observable rebinding/transport checks.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: A small proof-helper test with explicit sound/unsound modular cases. Keep for residue/range-proof changes; it does not impose FP precision.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Submission stdout must be clean on a rejected input. Keep as CLI contract/integrity.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Predicate-vs-numeric mask handling is relevant; branch/selp instruction choice is not the requirement.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Exact integer operations and widths are valid requirements; the exact native lowering sequence is a targeted backend assertion.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: 64-bit floor/remainder semantics are real. Mandatory div/rem/selp instructions may reject a correct strength-reduced implementation.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: No numeric conversion is the invariant. Requiring mov.b32 rejects a valid zero-instruction bitcast/register alias.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Select is a supported optional extension; predicate/selp/bar.warp spelling should be scoped to this backend mechanism.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: No illegal unsigned PTX is a valid assembly requirement; requiring mov.u32 for unsigned abs rejects legal alias elimination.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Mandatory assembly/entry-name coverage for actual published IR; assembly is not GPU numerical proof.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Storage width/result semantics are valid, but fixed mul.rn.f16, cvt.f32.f16 and shared declaration spelling are implementation choices. An equivalent promoted implementation or alternate shared allocation can be legal.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: Several computed math results are dead: only sign is written. DCE may legally remove sin/cos/erf/gelu/tanh and violate these opcode assertions. Export every tested result or test each operation separately before treating absence as failure.

tests.run_when: affected compiler mechanism; all-published assembly check remains mandatory
tests.assessment: A capability/clean-rejection check; accepting a correct pow implementation is already permitted. It does not prescribe exact arithmetic.
